# netcup_user_vlans (Data Source)

The VLANs of the netcup SCP user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_user_vlans" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_id` (Number) Only VLANs of this server.

### Read-Only

- `vlans` (Attributes List) VLANs of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans))

<a id="nestedatt--vlans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth_class` (Attributes) Bandwidth class of the VLAN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans--bandwidth_class))
- `name` (String) Name of the VLAN.
- `site` (Attributes) Site of the VLAN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans--site))
- `user` (Attributes) User the VLAN belongs to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans--user))
- `vlan_id` (Number) Id of the VLAN.

<a id="nestedatt--vlans--bandwidth_class"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans.bandwidth_class`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Id of the class.
- `name` (String) Name of the class.
- `speed_in_mbit` (Number) Speed in MBit/s.


<a id="nestedatt--vlans--site"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans.site`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) City of the site.
- `id` (Number) Id of the site.
- `name` (String) Name of the site.


<a id="nestedatt--vlans--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans.user`

Read-Only:

- `company` (String) Company.
- `email` (String) E-mail address.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `id` (Number) Id of the user.
- `lastname` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) User name.
